Why PurBlu

Close to home. Clear from tank to pickup.

We believe local food should come with a clear story. PurBlu raises shrimp here in Jordan and handles each harvest on the farm for nearby customers.

01

Raised nearby

Our shrimp grow in indoor tanks right here in Jordan, Minnesota.

02

Direct from the grower

Local pickup connects you with the people raising and harvesting your food.

03

Know the process

Our feed contains no antibiotics. At harvest, we net, chill, sort, package, and keep the shrimp on ice.

What you’ll take home

Whole shrimp, ready for the way you like to cook.

Whole means the heads and shells are still on. Cook them whole for the grill or table, or remove the heads and shells before cooking. Keeping the shrimp whole also gives you the shells and heads for a flavorful stock.

Common questions

The details before harvest day.

Here are the answers we can confirm today. Ordering, payment, cancellation, delivery, and availability details will be added once the complete customer flow is ready.

Where is pickup?

16650 Pueblo Blvd, Jordan, MN 55352, during the announced pickup window.

What does “whole shrimp” mean?

The head and shell are intact. You can cook them whole or clean and peel them first.

What quantities are available?

1 lb, 5 lb, 10 lb packages at $22 per pound.

Do you deliver?

Delivery is not confirmed. Current harvest details are for pickup in Jordan.

How should I keep shrimp cold?

Bring an insulated cooler with ice or cold packs. See our preparation page for storage and cooking guidance.
